lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_5 : CompleteSpace F] {f : F → ℝ} {g : E → F}
  {α σ : ℝ} {z : F},
  0 < α →
    0 ≤ σ →
      StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f →
        Differentiable ℝ f →
          Differentiable ℝ g →
            Function.Surjective g →
              IsMinOn f Set.univ z →
                (∀ (x : E) (v : F),
                    σ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ v ((fderiv ℝ g x) ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ g x)) v))) →
                  ∃ xstar,
                    g xstar = z ∧
                      IsMinOn (f ∘ g) Set.univ xstar ∧
                        ∀ (x : E), 2 * (α * σ) * ((f ∘ g) x - (f ∘ g) xstar) ≤ ‖gradient (f ∘ g) x‖ ^ 2
approved_definition_context: StrongConvexOn univ a f means the global convex chord inequality with subtraction (a/2)*t*(1-t)*norm(y-x)^2 for t in [0,1].

Differentiable R f means Frechet differentiability at every point. fderiv R f x is the actual continuous linear derivative; gradient f x is its Riesz representing vector on a complete real inner-product space. Differentiability does not assert continuity of the derivative.
For a continuous linear map A:E to F, its adjoint maps F to E and satisfies inner(A-adjoint v,u)=inner(v,A u). Both inner products are the specified real Hilbert inner products.
IsMinOn h univ w means h(w)<=h(x) for every x. Function.Surjective g means every element of its codomain has a preimage. Function composition f∘g means x maps to f(g(x)).
